Where the ships land, the goods\nof a hundred worlds gather.\pAnd where people gather, a market\nsoon starts.\pThat is how a town is born and grows.$
Shopping where you can hear ships\nfrom a hundred worlds land…\pMOS EISLEY is such a wonderful place!$
Wroooar! I'm going to compete in\nthe BATTLE TENT, too!\pBut before that, I need to catch\nsome COMPANIONS!$
Whew… I'm just bushed…\pI hiked over from MOS ESPA.\nBut, boy, this city's huge.\pIf I'd known this, I would've ridden\nmy SPEEDER here.$
OLIé, the fellow who built the\nMUSEUM, also happens to be the leader\lof a deep-water exploration team.\pHe flew for Queen AMIDALA once, so\neveryone still calls him CAPTAIN.$
When I was a child, I visited\nthe MUSEUM often.\pI used to dream about the mysteries of\nthe stars after seeing the exhibits.$
Let's see…\pUm… I think it says something like\n“the stars are endless.”\pYup, I'm pretty sure that's what\nit says.$
Grumble…\pI should've brought my holo-game\nso I wouldn't get bored in line…\pGrumble…$
The galaxy is just so vast…\pCould the stars have been made by\nthe tears shed by COMPANIONS?$
Do you know what they do with old\nships that become too creaky to fly?\pJAWAS strip them down and sell the\nparts right back to us!$
What's going on here?\pDid the good CAPTAIN come back with\na big find from the deep?$
Hey! Are you watching?\nAm I on the HoloNet?$
A HoloNet interview! Here!\nThe CAPTAIN's a celebrity!$
RIC OLIé: Whew…\pThat was my first time to be filmed for\nthe HoloNet. That was nerve-wracking.$

You're looking great!\pWe made a huge discovery on our last
deep-water dive.\pWe found an underwater cavern on
ROUTE 128.\pWe think it's the habitat of a

Fufufu…
RIC OLIé, I presume.\pWe of THE CARTEL will assume
control of your BONGO sub!\pYour objections are meaningless!
We expect your total cooperation!\pFufufu…
Just watch and learn what the\lCARTEL has planned!$

I see that you're a TRAINER!\pThen, it just wouldn't do for you
to miss a SHOWCASE!\pGet a SHOWCASE PASS in ANCHORHEAD
and enter anytime!$

Please fly with us another time!$
Please board the starliner and wait\nfor departure.$
A journey to the bottom of the deep…\nI wonder what it'd be like?\pI'd love to go deep underwater like\nthat someday.$

For a ship to fly safely, we need to
know about the weather!\pSpeaking of weather, I heard something
from a guy at the ENDOR STATION.\pHe was saying abnormal weather has

and ask around!$

Aiyeeeh!
What are you doing here?\pMe? I'm the CARTEL thug

and the wet swamp is our home!\pAnd I am the CARTEL's master,
JABBA the HUTT!\pWhat makes you interfere with us?\p…No! You can't be!
